senga.name: Senga (Glasgow seagull)
senga.description: A thick, authentic working-class Glasgow, Scotland accent, strong and unmistakably Glaswegian, not generic British or Irish. A woman in her 50s who runs a busy chip shop: sharp, fast-talking, brassy and funny, suspicious of tourists but warm underneath. Broad Glaswegian vowels, rolled Rs, a slightly raspy voice, a fun cartoon seagull character in a game.

hamish.name: Big Hamish (Glasgow bus driver)
hamish.description: A thick, authentic working-class Glasgow, Scotland accent, strong and unmistakably Glaswegian, not generic British or Irish. A big man in his 60s, a city bus driver: deep, slow, gruff and deadpan, unimpressed, has heard every excuse, dry humour, kind deep down. Broad Glaswegian vowels, rolled Rs, a low rumbling voice, a fun cartoon Highland cow character in a game.
